Thermal runaway risk is low (Da_thermal << 0.1) due to the exothermicity of SnAr being moderate and the high heat capacity of the solvent, but heat removal must be verified. The lab chemist MUST install a BPR set to at least 1.5 bar (recommended 2.0 bar) to maintain liquid phase integrity and ensure safety margins against vapor lock.
